name: Query Drug Interactions
description: Query drug-drug interactions from DDInter database to identify potential interactions, mechanisms, and severity levels between specified drugs.
detailed_description: Query drug-drug interactions from DDInter database to identify potential interactions, mechanisms, and severity levels between specified drugs.
when_to_use: When you need query drug interactions analysis

parameters.drug_names: [Required] List of drug names to query for interactions (List[str])
parameters.interaction_types: [Optional] Filter results by specific interaction types
parameters.severity_levels: [Optional] Filter results by severity levels (Major, Moderate, Minor)
parameters.data_lake_path: [Optional] Path to data lake directory containing DDInter data
